title: benzoin aromaticum
intro: Benzoin aromaticum, commonly known as Styrax resin, is a plant-based resin obtained from the bark of the Styrax tree, particularly Styrax tonkinensis. The health benefits of benzoin aromaticum include its ability to aid in wound healing, reduce inflammation, and provide relief from pain and anxiety. The therapeutic actions of benzoin aromaticum include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which make it effective in treating skin conditions and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of benzoin aromaticum include benzaldehyde, cinnamic acid, and resinic acid, which contribute to its therapeutic effects.
